column1: # core/data/talk/categories.tsv - the word network's category tree (owner:
# TK, T1; docs/TALK.md "The word network"). Read by core/tools/talkc.py.
# KEY    a root ("food"), or root.leaf ("food.dish"): two levels at most.
#        The roots come first, in talk.h's TCR_* order (talkc checks it);
#        each leaf follows its root's block. Ids are the line order
#        (1 = the first root), so APPEND leaves at the end of their root's
#        block only when nothing has saved them yet (only concept ids are
#        saved, in talk memory; category ids are not).
# FLAGS  talk      can be a conversation topic
#        gated     romance: adults only, the gate decides (docs/TALK.md K-4)
#        safety    recognised by the parser, never generated
# SENT   the default sentiment -3..3 of the leaf's concepts (a row may say
#        its own); REG / AGE the defaults of its rows (clean / any unless
#        said); ATTRS the attributes a row without any gets (concept keys
# A leaf inherits nothing from its root but its place in the tree.
